readmeMarkdown:
# Canvas Wallpaper (`agy-canvas-bg`)

> **Zero-occlusion custom wallpapers and procedural ambient backgrounds for the Antigravity 2.0 conversation canvas.**

[繁體中文說明](README.zh-TW.md) · [Agent Install Prompt](docs/INSTALL_AGENT.md) · [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md) · [MIT License](LICENSE)

**Canvas Wallpaper** (`agy-canvas-bg`) is a zero-dependency Node.js ESM plugin for **Antigravity 2.0**. It enhances the main conversation canvas with custom raster wallpapers or procedural ambient themes while strictly preserving message readability, interactive controls, and full compatibility with `agy-powertools`.

---

## Features (v1.0.0)

### 1. Zero-Occlusion Architecture
- **Conversation-canvas only**: Targets only `[data-testid="conversation-view"]` (and empty new conversation views). The left sidebar, top title bar, and right auxiliary pane keep their native solid surfaces.
- **Stacking safety**: Creates `isolation: isolate` on `[data-agy-canvas-bg-host="true"]` without setting `overflow: hidden` on the host, preserving `agy-powertools` focus halos and glow beams. Wallpaper and veil layers sit at `z-index: -2` / `-1` with `pointer-events: none`.
- **Protected surfaces**: Input box (`agent-input-box`), user message bubbles (`user-message-bubble`), `pre`/`code` blocks, tool collapsibles, `.xterm` terminals, menus, and dialogs remain protected above the backdrop.
- **Composer fade-strip cleanup**: Automatically clears distracting top fade strips and empty upward shadows right above the composer while restoring inline styles cleanly on disable or dispose.

### 2. Background Sources, Ask AI & Smart Auto-Tone
- **Custom Raster Images**: Upload PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, or AVIF (up to 8 MB, magic-byte validated). Supports **Shared** (single wallpaper) or **Separate** (distinct Dark & Light slot images) pairing, client-side downscaling (`<= 2560px`), and **Smart Auto-Tone** luminance/dark-ratio analysis with one-click **Auto-Tune**.
- **Ask AI with Screenshot**: When an image wallpaper is active, click **Open AI Tune Chat** to capture a live CDP canvas screenshot and open a new Antigravity conversation prefilled with your preset prompt, wallpaper path, and current settings so the AI can directly inspect and adjust the layout.
- **Procedural Ambient Themes**: Zero-image pure CSS and geometric SVG data-URI backgrounds (`aurora-mesh`, `dot-matrix`, `blueprint-grid`, `soft-grain`, `radial-glow`) with theme accent sync, primary/secondary hex colors, scale (`50–200%`), and opacity (`0–100%`).

### 3. Visual Tuning, Surface Material & Power Guard
- **Cover & Watermark / Side-Art Modes**: Full-canvas `cover` mode or `watermark` mode with 6 anchor positions (`right-side`, `left-side`, `bottom-right`, `bottom-left`, `top-right`, `top-left`), adjustable size (`18–75%`), and feathering (`15–85%`).
- **Independent Dark & Light Profiles**: Per-theme visibility (safety-capped at `60%` cover / `75%` watermark, unlockable to `100%`), blur (`0–24px`), saturation (`0–120%`), brightness (`40–130%`), contrast (`80–135%`), blend modes (`normal`, `screen`, `multiply`, `soft-light`), center veil, reading backdrop, **2D Focal Point** crosshair (`positionX`/`positionY`), **Scale** (`100–200%`), and **Flip X**.
- **Surface Material & Edge Vignette**: Opt-in translucent card material (`cardOpacity` `75–100%`, `cardBlur` `0–24px`) scoped strictly to composer/user-bubble/overview cards (automatically reverted in `forced-colors: active`), plus `readingStyle` (`halo`, `card`, `none`), `textShadow` (`off`, `subtle`, `crisp`), and `edgeVignette` (`0–60%`).
- **Animation Power Guard**: Captures a static first frame for animated GIF/WebP wallpapers and pauses playback on window blur/hidden tab or when `prefers-reduced-motion` is enabled.
- **Scoped Custom CSS**: Up to 8 KB of user CSS (`</style` sanitized), automatically unloaded whenever the wallpaper is disabled.

### 4. Wallpaper Library, Rotation & Workspaces
- **Wallpaper Library & Rotation**: Store up to 24 wallpapers with favorites, instant apply/delete, **Shuffle Now**, and automatic rotation (`off`, `conversation`, `interval`, `daily`).
- **Built-in & Custom Presets**: 4 built-in presets (`anime-dark`, `anime-bright`, `side-art`, `subtle`) plus up to 20 custom presets, and JSON Settings / portable Theme Pack (`.json`) export & import.
- **Per-Workspace Bindings**: Bind up to 30 workspace URIs to specific presets/images or disable wallpapers in distraction-free workspaces.
- **9 UI Languages**: Auto-detect (`auto`) plus `English`, `繁體中文`, `简体中文`, `日本語`, `한국어`, `Français`, `Deutsch`, `Español`, and `Русский`.

### 5. Low-Overhead Runtime Design
- **Metadata-Cached Stores**: `settings.json`, `images/meta.json`, and `images/library.json` use `statSync` (`mtimeMs`, `size`, `ino`) read caches so unchanged polls avoid redundant disk reads and JSON parsing, while returning isolated clones.
- **Debounced & Pruned DOM Scanning**: The renderer uses a `250ms` trailing debounce, skips mutations inside streaming response/code/terminal subtrees, prunes `TreeWalker` scans past protected surfaces, caches `parseRgb` lookups (256 entries), throttles stack probes, and emits `filter: none` for neutral defaults.
- **Conditional Asset Caching & Idle Poll Guard**: The Aux Pane server responds with metadata-based `ETag` / `304 Not Modified` for slot and library images before reading bytes, while the client pauses status polling when the tab is hidden, preserves active slider/focal-point interactions, and diffs DOM signatures before re-rendering.
- **Idle CDP Poll Skipping**: `cdp-host` skips redundant `setSettings` evaluations and unchanged `diagnostics.json` writes during idle polls, with gentle backoff when no debug port is open.

---

## Requirements & Installation

- **Antigravity 2.0**
- **Node.js 22+** (zero third-party npm packages required)

### Option A: Antigravity CLI (Recommended)

```bash
agy plugin install https://github.com/tz7543/agy-canvas-bg
```

Validate or uninstall anytime via:
```bash
agy plugin validate --strict https://github.com/tz7543/agy-canvas-bg
agy plugin uninstall agy-canvas-bg
```

### Option B: Install Script

**macOS / Linux / WSL2:**
```bash
git clone https://github.com/tz7543/agy-canvas-bg agy-canvas-bg
cd agy-canvas-bg
./install.sh
```

**Windows (PowerShell):**
```powershell
git clone https://github.com/tz7543/agy-canvas-bg agy-canvas-bg
cd agy-canvas-bg
.\install.ps1
```

Both scripts copy only runtime files (`plugin.json`, `package.json`, `README.md`, `assets/`, `lib/`, `sidecars/`, `skills/`) to `${AGY_PLUGINS_DIR:-~/.gemini/config/plugins}/agy-canvas-bg` without touching your existing `plugin_data`.

### Option C: Ask Your Antigravity Agent
Paste the prompt from [docs/INSTALL_AGENT.md](docs/INSTALL_AGENT.md) into an Antigravity conversation to have the agent install and verify the plugin safely.

### Uninstall
- **macOS / Linux / WSL2:** `./uninstall.sh` (preserves wallpapers/settings; add `--purge-data` to remove user data)
- **Windows (PowerShell):** `.\uninstall.ps1` (preserves wallpapers/settings; add `-PurgeData` to remove user data)

---

## Passive CDP Connection & Platform Setup

`agy-canvas-bg` **never** modifies Antigravity binaries, **never** edits `~/.gemini/config/config.json`, and **never** kills or force-restarts Antigravity. It passively polls Antigravity's `DevToolsActivePort` file and attaches only to local Antigravity Desktop loopback pages.

If Antigravity was launched without a remote debugging port, open it manually using `--remote-debugging-port=0` (or use the opt-in helper scripts):

| Platform | Manual Command / Helper |
| :--- | :--- |
| **macOS** | `./scripts/launch-with-debug.sh` (`open -n -a "/Applications/Antigravity.app" --args --remote-debugging-port=0`) |
| **Windows (PowerShell)** | `.\scripts\launch-with-debug.ps1` (`"%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Antigravity\Antigravity.exe" --remote-debugging-port=0`) |
| **Linux** | `./scripts/launch-with-debug.sh` (`antigravity --remote-debugging-port=0`) |
| **WSL2** | Launch Antigravity on Windows with `--remote-debugging-port=0` (`.\scripts\launch-with-debug.ps1`). When running inside WSL2, `agy-canvas-bg` automatically falls back to `/mnt/c/Users/<winUser>/AppData/Roaming/Antigravity/DevToolsActivePort` if no Linux port file exists. |

### Coexistence with `agy-powertools`
`agy-canvas-bg` and `agy-powertools` are fully isolated:
- Separate plugin directories, separate persistent `plugin_data` folders, and separate sidecar ports.
- `agy-canvas-bg` excludes `/powertools`, `/customizations`, `/automations`, and `/settings` routes, protects `[data-agy-powertools-root]`, `.pt-tip-pop`, and `[data-testid^="agy-"]`, and avoids `overflow: hidden` on the host so `agy-powertools` beams and halos render unclipped.

---

## Agent Skill

The bundled skill `skills/canvas-wallpaper/SKILL.md` (`canvas-wallpaper`) lets your Antigravity agent help you open `[Canvas Wallpaper](sidecar://agy-canvas-bg/wallpaper/)`, inspect `diagnostics.json`, tune settings, or switch presets while enforcing strict safety rules (no edits to `config.json` or app binaries).

---

## Privacy & Security Boundaries

- **100% local**: No telemetry, no analytics, and no external API keys or third-party endpoints. **Ask AI with Screenshot** only calls Antigravity's local `ConversationService` (`ANTIGRAVITY_LS_ADDRESS`) to open a new chat in your existing Antigravity session and writes `ai-snapshots/canvas-latest.png` locally with `0600` permissions.
- **Authenticated local UI**: All `/api/*` Aux Pane routes require the per-session sidecar token and bind strictly to `127.0.0.1`.
- **Strict input validation**:
  - Image uploads and Theme Packs verify binary magic bytes (PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF/AVIF only; SVG, HTML, and text payloads are rejected).
  - Settings patches and imports reject unknown keys and prototype pollution keys (`__proto__`, `constructor`, `prototype`).
  - Library IDs are guarded by `^[a-z0-9_-]{6,64}$` against path traversal.
  - Scoped Custom CSS strips `</style` and caps size at 8192 bytes.
- **Isolated user data**: Stored in `${AGY_CANVAS_BG_DATA_DIR:-~/.gemini/antigravity/plugin_data/agy-canvas-bg}` with `0600` file permissions.

---

## Development & Verification

```bash
npm run check
npm test
agy plugin validate --strict .
```
